ScrollArea applies smooth edge fade masks automatically whenever content overflows along the vertical or horizontal axis.

As you scroll down, the top mask fades in proportionally to the scroll offset, while the bottom mask fades out once you reach the end of the container.

Combined with overscrollContain, wheel and touch gestures stay contained inside the panel without pulling the parent page along.

Overlay scrollbars remain hidden at rest and appear cleanly on hover or active scrolling, keeping dense interfaces uncluttered.

); }
